body: Owner merged #297, #298 and #299 (main 48837767, same tree as the tested 1000e323). Lab e2e of the CI installer (run 37865273929) on Windows 11 Arm64: install, Start launch, onboarding, dark theme, caption glyphs, maximise, double-click restore (needs a fast native double-click; vmlab's VNC double-click is slower than Flutter's 300 ms), minimise, drag, snap, every edge resize, Ctrl+B/I/Z, spell check with suggestions, clipboard paste and Explorer drop of photos, save, Calendar, Search, export zip contents, uninstall, reinstall keeping data. VC runtime risk closed: binaries import only msvcp140, vcruntime140, vcruntime140_1 (bundled 14.51.36247). Lab GPU loses the D3D11 device under Flutter; testing ran on the Microsoft Basic Display Adapter, where the Meadow saturates the VM. Found and fixed the export dialog bug in PR #300 (fix/windows-export-dialog, 7479ff08), reviewed twice by code-reviewer and once by security-reviewer; lab kept 10 proof and 2 issue screenshots under feature windows-release. Android signing secrets are still unset (gh secret list empty), so a v* tag today would fail the android job and publish nothing.
